name: Transmogrification
description: Transmogrify gear appearance via the Transmogrifier NPC.

keys.label: Enable transmog
keys.explain: Enables/Disables transmog. Players won't be able to see any transmogrified item while disabled, however, database data remains intact.

keys.label: Show the set disclaimer
keys.explain: If enabled, players receive a chat notice when transmogrifying an item that belongs to a set, explaining that set bonuses remain active even though the tooltip won't reflect them. Players can suppress the notice per-character with: .transmog disclaimer off

keys.label: Legion-style appearance collection
keys.explain: Enables/Disables Legion-style appearance collection system. If enabled, players can use the appearance of any item equipped or rewarded from a completed quest. If disabled, players must have an item in their bags to use as a transmogrification appearance source.

keys.label: Use the vendor interface
keys.explain: Enables/Disables the use of a fake vendor interface for item selection. If enabled, players can select items from a vendor menu, complete with ctrl-click previews. If disabled, players will use the gossip menu to select items and will not have access to previews.

keys.label: Allow hidden (invisible) transmog
keys.explain: Enables/Disables the hiding of equipment through transmog. If enabled, players can select an "invisible" appearance for items at the transmog vendor.
